title: Pattern
description: A saved one-bar pattern of 16 steps; playback may loop the first 8. Missing sounds remain recoverable; never silently replace a removed variant. Optional fields default as documented so older saved patterns stay valid.

id.description: Internal UUID, never the editable name.

swing.description: Playback swing: first note's percentage of a pair, 50 is straight. Default 50. App groove control, not a hardware preset emulation.

swingGrid.description: Swing note division. Default 16. Eighth-note swing delays steps 3-4 of each four-step group; sixteenth-note swing delays every second step.

circuit.description: Apply the current machine's documented hardware timing (swing tick positions, measured step jitter) when the app has data for it. Default false.

length.description: Loop length in steps. Default 16. With 8, steps 9-16 are kept but not played.

pitchCents.description: Overall sample tuning in integer cents for every instrument in this pattern (100 cents = 1 semitone). Raised pitch shortens the sample. Default 0. Adds to each track's per-step offsets.

echo.description: Tape echo and spring reverb modelled on the Roland RE-201 Space Echo. Absent means the default settings with the echo off. Knob values are 0 to 1 at two decimals.

on.description: Echo in circuit. Off mutes the tape input; repeats already on the tape fade out.

heads.description: Playback heads 1, 2 and 3 in the echo mix.

rate.description: REPEAT RATE: tape speed, 1 is fastest (shortest repeats). Ignored while sync is set.

sync.description: Tempo sync of the earliest active head; absent or null for the free REPEAT RATE.

bass.description: BASS of the echo; 0.5 is flat.

treble.description: TREBLE of the echo; 0.5 is flat.

input.description: INPUT VOLUME into the preamp and tape; 0.5 is unity.

gainDb.description: Drum volume offset in dB applied to every hit of this track. Default 0.

levels.description: Per-step level, 0 (silent) to 1 (full). Amplitude = level squared. Default all 1.

stepPitchCents.description: Per-step pitch offsets in integer cents added to the pattern's overall pitch (100 cents = 1 semitone). Exactly 16 entries; default all 0. Offsets survive a step being off and remain editable outside the 8-step loop.

echoSend.description: Send level into the tape echo, 0 to 1; amplitude is the send squared. Default 1.
